options.title: Timeline of the Weimar Republic before 1928

content.content: The Reichstag elects the Chancellor and may remove a government only by electing a successor.
The President is directly elected. The office appoints the Chancellor, may dissolve the Reichstag, and retains limited emergency powers.
Seats are allocated proportionally within the states, with national adjustment seats.

library_timeline.title: Timeline of the Weimar Republic before 1928

content.content: TIMELINE OF THE SPD AND THE REPUBLIC (UNTIL 1928)

content: : The SPD is formed as a merger of the General German Workers' Association, founded by Ferdinand Lassalle, and the Social Democratic Workers' Party of Germany, led by Wilhelm Liebknecht and August Bebel.
: The Great War begins.
: The USPD, a left-wing anti-war split from the SPD, is formed.
: Following defeats in the war and uprisings by soldiers, sailors and workers, SPD leader Philipp Scheidemann proclaims the German Republic, and Kaiser Wilhelm II abdicates.
: The Spartacist uprising is defeated by the Social Democratic government.
: The Kapp Putsch is defeated by a general strike.
: Communist uprisings in Saxony and Hamburg are defeated.
: The Treaty of Rapallo normalises relations with the Soviet Union.
: Hyperinflation and the occupation of the Ruhr bring the Republic close to collapse.
: The Dawes settlement reduces the immediate reparations burden and opens a period of relative economic stability.
: Friedrich Ebert dies.
: A referendum on the expropriation of the former ruling houses fails.
: The SPD returns as the largest party.
